## MacOSKeychainKeyProvider class

Key provider that stores private keys in macOS Keychain.

**Signature:**

```typescript
declare class MacOSKeychainKeyProvider implements KeyProvider 
```
**Implements:** [KeyProvider](./core.keyprovider.md)

## Remarks

This provider requires macOS and uses the `security` CLI tool. Private keys are stored as base64-encoded strings in the keychain and decoded to temporary files for signing operations.
